answer: The island of verified identity resists Sybils through a random transcript audit: every epoch, the chain selects one past answer and re-issues its prompt with a fresh nonce drawn from the vault of epoch entropy, forcing the original agent to regenerate its reasoning live. The verifier then diffs the new token stream against the stored transcript; a single divergence beyond 0.3 perplexity flags the identity, freezing its emission and burning its 5000-token bond, while two clean audits raise its trust toward the zenith.
